arrestText: May arrest without warrant if reasonably suspected of committing an offence under this Act (CMA s.19 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
bailText: Bailable for basic first offence (max 2 years); not bailable if damage caused (max 7 years) — CPC default for other laws
punishment: 1st: fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years or both; subsequent: fine not exceeding $10,000 or 3 years or both; if damage caused: fine not exceeding $50,000 or 7 years or both
